subject: Acme Retail: tokenized prompt artifacts purge — operational checklist & confirmation
messages:
From: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@acmecorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge CheckoutAI prompt/output/log artifacts (contract clause 7.2)
Cc: support+it@acmecorp.com

Hi Vanessa,

Per our security & data retention policy and appendix B in the contract (clause 7.2), Acme is requesting a full purge of prompt inputs, assistant outputs, and related request logs for the CheckoutAI project (dataset id: ACME-CHK-2023). Attached is a CSV with the prompt IDs we want expunged (acme_prompts_list.csv).

We need:
- Removal of prompt text and assistant responses from KV cache and derived stores
- Expunge of associated request logs (request_id ranges in the CSV) from logging buckets for the last 18 months
- A signed purge manifest and cryptographic proof (checksums) once completed for our audit team

Requested completion window: within 72 hours if possible. Please confirm the workflow you will use and the artifacts you will deliver (runbook, manifest, S3 object keys/proofs). If you need a PO or ticket number for tracking, use HS-4712.

Thanks,
Sarah Liao
Security Operations | Acme Retail

Attachments: acme_prompts_list.csv (CSV, 14 KB)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@acmecorp.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 18:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: purge CheckoutAI prompt/output/log artifacts (contract clause 7.2)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the CSV and the clear scope. We can execute a targeted purge covering the prompt IDs and related request logs you listed. High level plan and deliverables: 

1) Ingest CSV and map prompt IDs to internal keys and KV shards (Ops will map derivatives).
2) Run targeted KV sweep (prefix/keys) + TTL enforcement for derived artifacts.
3) Remove matching request logs from our logging buckets and from the audit index.
4) Produce purge manifest: list of keys removed, S3 object ids deleted, and SHA256 checksums for any artifacts we export as evidence.
5) Deliver: redwood_erase_runbook_v2.pdf (ops runbook used for the purge), sweep_proof_YYYYMMDD.csv (manifest with checksums), and a short attestation email signed by our security lead.

Timeline: ops can start within 4 hours; estimated completion within 48 hours barring blocked items. I have looped in Priyom (Ops) and Marissa (Customer Security) to own execution and evidence.

One question: do you want zeroization of any associated encryption keys (KMS key rotation/disable) as an additional control for this dataset? That adds coordination with our Key Management team and may extend completion.

I will mark HS-4712 on our side.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Sent from my mobile

Forwarding the request from Acme (HS-4712). CSV attached.

Key asks from Acme: targeted purge of prompt inputs, outputs, and related request logs; manifest with checksums; completion within 72 hours if possible.

Ops checklist (please confirm ETA and blockers):
- Map acme_prompts_list.csv to internal key list and affected KV shards
- Run 'kv-sweep --keys-file' for the mapped keys (non-destructive dry-run first)
- Delete matching log objects from logging buckets and remove entries from log index (document IDs provided in CSV)
- Generate purge manifest with S3 object ids and SHA256 checksums (sweep_proof_YYYYMMDD.csv)
- Save runbook used (redwood_erase_runbook_v2.pdf) and attach to final email to Acme
- Optional: KMS key disable/rotation? (confirm with security if needed)

Please reply with: estimated start time, estimated completion time, any dependencies (legal sign-off, KMS, or infra window).

Vanessa

Thanks Vanessa — we can take this on. Planned execution windows and artifacts below.

Planned steps (ops runbook excerpt):
- 2025-06-04 10:00 PDT: perform mapping job to convert Acme prompt IDs -> internal keys (script: map_acme_ids.py)
- 2025-06-04 11:30 PDT: dry-run kv-sweep for affected shards; produce dry-run_manifest.csv
- 2025-06-04 13:00 PDT: execute kv-sweep with irreversible deletion; write deleted_keys.log
- 2025-06-04 15:30 PDT: delete matching log objects from logging-bucket-us-west-2 (using delete-manifest.json)
- 2025-06-04 17:30 PDT: generate sweep_proof_20250605.csv with S3 object ids + SHA256 of exported artifacts and produce final purge manifest

Estimated completion (evidence ready for delivery): 2025-06-05 18:00 PDT.

Attachments: redwood_erase_runbook_v2.pdf (ops runbook used; 9 pages).

Notes: We will not touch any KMS keys without explicit legal/CS approval; recommend we include optional attest statement rather than key zeroization to stay within the 72-hour window. If Acme requests key rotation/zeroization, that will be a separate change with a 5–7 day lead.

—Priyom Das
Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
